save_reconstructions_to_h5: save a dictionary of numpy array reconstructions as h5 files to an output directory
convert_fnames_to_v2: rename all h5 files in a directory to append _v2 suffix for knee leaderboard submission
review_save_reconstructions: review the save_reconstructions function that writes reconstruction arrays to h5 files for leaderboard submission
review_convert_fnames_to_v2: review the convert_fnames_to_v2 function that renames h5 files to conform to v2 knee data standard
test_save_reconstructions: test the save_reconstructions function by passing a dict of filenames to numpy arrays and verifying h5 output
